attachment styles are important in bariatric surgery candidates.

The main takeaway from our work is that

patients who are anxious and/or avoidant about their attachment to others are more likely to have a less positive evaluation of their suitability for bariatrics by a psychologist, and that this is mediated by symptoms of depression and/or anxiety.
psychologists’ evaluations of bariatric surgery candidates may be influenced by patients’ symptoms of depression and/or anxiety.
